title: Logo / Product and partnership lockups
slide_intent: Coordinate adjacent names so viewers can read product and partnership relationships without losing the Uber identifier.
strategic_value: Shared alignment and spacing can connect Uber Air and a Spotify partnership to the same parent identity.
demonstration: Two rows compare Uber Air vertical and horizontal product lockups with a horizontal Uber–Spotify partnership lockup; blue U forms and guide lines expose spacing.
practical_value: Choose a product or partnership construction and use its illustrated alignment and stated spacing guidance.

content_islands.name: Product lockups
content_islands.spec: Keep the product explanation in the upper left and the vertical and horizontal Uber Air constructions side by side in the upper right.

content_islands.name: Partnership lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the partnership instructions below the product explanation and align the Uber–Spotify construction opposite them.

ingredient.name: Product and partnership lockups
ingredient.role: Make a relationship between identities readable.
ingredient.application: Follow clearspace rules for partnership logos; the separator can use the Uber Move Display Light vertical-line glyph at the same size as the logo.
ingredient.scope: Partner and sponsor guide; product examples use Uber Air and the partnership example uses Spotify.

reference_purposes.Expression: Uber Air and Uber–Spotify specimens show how additional names sit beside the wordmark.
reference_purposes.Application: The product constructions show vertical and horizontal arrangements; the partnership specimen shows a separator between brands.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Partnership logos must follow clearspace rules; the separator can use the vertical-line glyph in Uber Move Display Light at the logo’s size.
